title: Bondy — Cluster Sync / AAE
description: Cluster-wide anti-entropy health: node × peer sync matrix, frontier convergence, pair inspector, Partisan link health. Start at the AE-health stats; anything non-green links deeper.

panels.title: AE health — cluster at a glance
Frontier-gap verdicts (15m)
panels.description: Completed sync rounds that left a peer strictly ahead after settle. A single verdict per (instance, peer) is a benign door-fold transient that heals next round; sustained growth or repeats mean a standing gap — check the node × peer matrix below. NOTE: this is an EVENT window — it stays lit for 15m after the last verdict even once healed (counters do not go down). The overview's "Standing frontier gaps" stat is the state-gated view.

panels.title: Re-bootstraps scheduled (15m)
panels.description: Catalogue re-bootstraps: a peer reclaimed pages this replica needs, or a frontier gap struck twice. Any non-zero value deserves a look — frequent re-bootstraps under churn can clobber accumulator cells on fused instances without retention.

panels.title: Sync errors (15m)
panels.description: Failed AE sync sessions (all reasons: transient root_unservable retries, page-pull failures, frontier gaps). Compare against the ok rate below; a rising error share on one pair points at that link.

panels.title: Doored events (15m)
panels.description: Never-applied peer events accepted by the watermark door (folded or held) instead of silently dropped. Non-zero under load is NORMAL and healthy — it is the door doing its job. A sudden explosion means watermarks are racing far ahead of delivery.

panels.title: Instances DIVERGED
panels.description: Instances whose applied-frontier hash differs across nodes right now. Transient divergence during load is expected; a value that does not return to 0 when writes quiesce is a real convergence failure.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance_id)(count_values by (instance_id)("h", bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash) > 0) > 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stalest pair sync age
panels.description: Oldest (instance, peer) last-completed-sync age on any node. The matrix below shows which pair.

panels.title: Cluster sync state — node × peer matrix
Last completed sync age (s) — row syncs FROM column
panels.description: Whole-cluster sync state in one view: worst last-completed-sync age across all instances, for each (node, peer) pair. Green = pairs syncing on cadence. A red ROW = that node cannot pull from anyone (look at its scheduler / load). A red COLUMN = nobody can pull from that peer (look at that node's responder / connectivity). Drill: set pairA/pairB above and use the Pair inspector below.

panels.title: Frontier-gap verdicts (1h) — row saw column ahead
panels.description: Gap verdicts per (node, peer) over the last hour. 1 = benign door-fold transient (self-heals via the origin one round later). 2+ on the same cell = the two-strike rebootstrap threshold fired — a standing gap; check Re-bootstraps and the pair inspector.

panels.title: Gap verdicts, re-bootstraps & MST rebuilds (5m rate)
panels.description: The trend the stats summarize: verdicts should be rare spikes that return to zero. A staircase = a standing gap re-striking every round. MST rebuilds = the unservable-own-root self-heal fired — the shard recovered, but investigate why root pages went missing.

panels.title: Watermark-door events by action (5m rate)
panels.description: fold = fused instances folding never-applied events inline; held = applier-backed instances holding them for replay. Sustained high rates track write volume; they are the honest alternative to silent data loss.

panels.title: Scrape up
panels.description: Prometheus can reach the node's Admin API /metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Membership view size
panels.description: partisan_peer_service:members() as seen by each node.

panels.title: Cluster health
panels.description: 1 only when every node reaches every member of its view.

panels.title: Node ready
panels.description: Same flag the /ready probe serves.

panels.title: Active alarms
panels.description: OTP alarms (e.g. system_memory_high_watermark), all nodes.

panels.title: Connectivity matrix (observer × peer)
panels.description: Each cell: can the row's node reach the column's peer? Green = connected.

panels.title: Peer connectivity history
panels.description: Per (observer, peer) link state over time; red bands are partitions or restarts.

panels.title: Instances converged
panels.description: Instances whose applied-frontier hash is identical on every selected node (includes solo instances).

panels.title: Instances DIVERGED
panels.description: Instances reporting different applied-frontier hashes across nodes. Transient during writes; persistent divergence means AAE is not converging.

panels.title: AAE lww merge conflicts
panels.description: Remote AAE merges that replaced a DIFFERENT local value of an authorization cell (lww). Investigate any sustained activity: a concurrent edit lost.

panels.title: Sync session duration
panels.description: Distribution of AAE sync session durations.

panels.title: Peer root-checkpoint age (stalest pair vs typical)
panels.description: Age of the last CONFIRMED peer-root checkpoint per (shard, peer) pair — the reclamation-stability signal, NOT sync cadence. A quiet shard whose peer has fully compacted advertises no MST root, so its checkpoint is deliberately frozen even though sync sessions keep running (see the Sync sessions panel for cadence). Worry only if the MEDIAN grows while writes are flowing.

panels.title: Substrate AE freshness lag (max per namespace)
Frontier sync matrix — $nodeA ⇢ (diverged shard count per peer)
⇢ $nodeB
panels.description: Number of shards whose applied-frontier hash differs between $nodeA and $nodeB. Click to inspect the pair.

targets.expr: count(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$nodeA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$nodeB"})) or vector(0)
count(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last sync age ($pairA → $pairB)
panels.description: Oldest last-completed-sync across $pairA's instances against $pairB.

panels.title: Diverged shards between pair over time

targets.expr: count(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Diverged shards: frontier seq delta ($pairA vs $pairB)
panels.description: Shards whose frontiers differ between the pair, with the absolute applied-sequence gap (how far apart).

targets.expr: abs(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairA"}) - max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairB"})) and on (instance_id) (max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"}))

panels.title: Largest frontier gaps (top 15)

targets.expr: topk(15, abs(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairA"}) - max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairB"})) and on (instance_id) (max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"})))

panels.description: Applied-sequence gap per diverged shard between the pair.

panels.title: AAE Sync — Oversized items (values too large to replicate over Partisan)
Oversized AAE sync items skipped — rate
panels.description: Rate of AAE sync items (MST pages or catalogue cells) skipped because a single item's serialized size exceeds the sync response ceiling (Partisan max_message_size × headroom). Non-zero means stored values are too large to replicate — raise cluster.max_message_size. Alert (the operator alarm): sum(increase(bondy_oplog_sync_oversized_item_total[15m])) > 0 — it self-clears once skipping stops.

panels.title: Largest skipped AAE sync item
panels.description: Largest AAE sync item skipped (over the visible range, by kind) because it exceeds the frame cap. Indicates how high cluster.max_message_size must be raised. A first-class SASL alarm (bondy_oplog_sync_oversized_items) also fires while skipping is ongoing — see the cluster overview's Active alarms.

panels.title: Inter-node RTT (quantiles)
panels.description: Partisan heartbeat round-trip across all peers/channels.

panels.title: Inter-node RTT (heatmap)
panels.description: RTT distribution over time.

panels.title: Send backpressure — pending bytes (by peer, side)
panels.description: Bytes queued to send but not flushed. Sustained > 0 = link can't keep up.

panels.title: Channel connections vs target (under-provisioned)
panels.description: size < target means a channel is running under its configured parallelism.

panels.title: Connect & TLS-handshake latency (p99, by result)
panels.description: A spike in handshake result=error is the slowloris signal.
